analysis_title: Timing pairing and controller consistency in a published industrial level loop
origin: Published SACAC industrial normal-operation record from an anonymous pulp and paper plant
row_count_resolution: CSV:904; Bauer et al.2019 Table2:904; accompanying TXT:903. Analysis uses all904 CSV rows before declared index restriction.
data_handling: Original CSV and TXT remain obtainable from official URLs with fetch_source.py. The distribution contains analysis outputs and code rather than republishing the raw input files.
evidence_scope: Exploratory reanalysis following initial screening of one published normal-operation trace. Not a new independently acquired plant trial.
provenance_limit: Industrial origin and variable roles are supported by the repository publication. Original historian export settings, compression, filtering, controller configuration and scan ordering were not independently recovered.
